_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 036 (FR-P2-07) — seed row for the AnalysisExecutionHandler 'refine' method: conversational refinement of the current analysis output via a focused inner LLM call.
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to AnalysisExecutionHandler via sprk_handlerclass; sprk_configuration.method = 'refine' selects the refinement pipeline. The active analysis id reaches the handler through ChatInvocationContext.AnalysisId (forwarded by ToolHandlerToAIFunctionAdapter from the session's AnalysisMetadata).
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000000 (Read) — fetches the current analysis output, transforms it with an inner LLM call, and returns text to the conversation. No persistence; never gated by class.
_comment_identity: The analysis read (IAnalysisOrchestrationService.GetAnalysisAsync) runs under application identity (audit F-2c-adjacent; G-P0 ruling accept-until-cutover). sprk_permissionscope = 'app-only-engine' declares it; P3 task 044 remediates the surviving app-only legs.
_comment_capability_gate: sprk_requiredcapability = 'reanalyze' — same gate as the sibling ANALYSIS-RERUN row (both lived behind the legacy 'reanalyze' capability block).
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' safety filter.
sprk_description: Refine the current analysis output based on a conversational follow-up instruction — adjust, expand, or narrow the existing analysis without re-running it (e.g. 'focus more on the risk factors', 'make the recommendations more actionable'). Fetches the session's current analysis output and applies the instruction with a focused single-turn transform, returning the complete refined analysis text. Requires an active analysis in the session.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — mirrors the legacy chat-only exposure.
